args.subject: Ticket C-2893: Retention corrected and refund issued
args.body:
Hi Contoso Ltd,

We have corrected your backup retention period to match your contract (365 days) and issued a refund of 80 for the storage overage. Your ticket is now closed.

Best regards,
Support Team
